_doc: Tokens that look like R-ruling citations but are not. A census row is excluded (method fp) when its file matches and its line (or JSON string) contains `match`; `ids` narrows it to those tokens. Rows the census itself labels fp (out-of-range numbers, `const R1 = …` identifiers, the docs/07 visual-redesign rounds R0–R5) are excluded without an entry here; these are the ones no heuristic can see. Matching is by text, not line number, so the list survives a rebase.
